FunctionAncestors lends the selected native source frame and its lexical parents. Go owns private Parent pointers, child membership, declaration objects and generic origins. The iterator adds no parent catalog or copied ancestor slice. It authenticates each current loan and preserves cancellation/stop; it makes no invocation or product initialization claim.

The native source matrix covers declaration, method, generic declaration and synthetic initializer roots, each at three native depths and under actual/copy identity. Eighteen malformed input/output roles start from an intact three-frame chain and assert both loan count and exact refusal identity. Bodyless declarations retain exact identity; genuine generic instantiations retain their native nil-package/origin contract. The real generic-package rejection and exact failed-only correction remain separate native attempts. Memory pressure independently varies sibling width32/8193 and ancestor depth8/257, checking first-loan allocation after native compilation. Ten controls (including the natural single-fact receiver red/green pair) remove selected/root ancestry, admit a copied bodyless declaration, ignore child membership, lose cancellation cause, ignore consumer stop, discard genuine generic origins copy the ancestor population, discard native receiver object origins or erase completion cancellation.
